comment: KYC / CDD documents requested in onboarding cases (brief 5.6, PLAN 7): one row per document request with document type (e.g. Certificate of Incorporation, Board Resolution, UBO Declaration, AML/CTF Questionnaire), mandatory flag, requested / received dates, status (Received, Outstanding, Waived, Cancelled), days to receive, days outstanding at 30-Sep-2026 and the case context (case status and stage, KYC Docs days, stuck in KYC Docs for more than 15 days, booking country, segment, owner). Documents are requested when the case enters KYC Docs. Grain: one row per document requested in an onboarding case.
